en.title: Kyushu Shinkansen suspends operations due to pantograph abnormality
en.summary: JR Kyushu suspended all Kyushu Shinkansen services in both directions after discovering an abnormality in the pantograph system. The suspension was implemented to conduct a full-line inspection for potential overhead cable damage.

en.title: EDWIN holds photo exhibition at 15 Tokyo laundromats exploring relationship between jeans and people
en.summary: Denim brand EDWIN is opening a photo exhibition from the 14th at its Tokyo Harajuku location, featuring works photographed at 15 coin laundromats across the city. The exhibition aims to showcase the relationship between people and clothing, and the appeal of wearing jeans long-term.

en.title: Apology letter from Hibari Misora revealed; legendary singer cancelled Iwaki visit despite wanting to go
en.summary: A replica of an apology letter written by singer Hibari Misora to the mayor of Iwaki in 1987 was displayed at a ceremony on the 12th. She had planned to promote the city as the setting for her song but cancelled due to health issues.

en.title: Explosion in Israel near Lebanon border kills student, injures 20 during hiking trip
en.summary: An explosion occurred near Israel's northern border with Lebanon, killing a teenage male student and injuring approximately 20 others on a hiking excursion. Local media reported that a student may have found an unexploded ordnance and placed it in a backpack before detonation.

en.title: 14-year-old boy fires hunting rifle at French middle school, injuring principal and female teacher; gun hidden in guitar case
en.summary: A 14-year-old student opened fire with a hunting rifle at a school building in Aubagne near Marseille in southern France, injuring a principal and female teachers. Staff members restrained the student in a hallway, and authorities arrested him on attempted murder charges.

en.title: 39-year-old eldest son arrested on assault charges; mother dies after being beaten, causation under investigation in Aichi Prefecture
en.summary: A 39-year-old unemployed man was arrested for assaulting his mother living with him, causing injuries to her face and other areas. The mother was found dead, and police are investigating the cause of death and any connection to the assault.

en.title: Home of former Somali refugee and U.S. Democratic congresswoman searched, report says; conflicts with Trump administration over immigration policy
en.summary: U.S. authorities searched the Washington-area home of Democratic Representative Ilhan Omar from Minnesota, a former Somali refugee. Omar has been critical of aggressive immigration enforcement by immigration authorities and has clashed with the Trump administration on immigration issues.

en.summary: A 24-year-old company employee was thrown from the hood of a light vehicle driven by a man in his 80s on a road in Aichi Prefecture, sustaining back injuries. Police are searching for the driver on attempted murder charges, with a possible traffic dispute occurring beforehand.
